scenarios.title: Authorized action
scenarios.preconditions: Pin one valid subject, resource and policy edition; use a clean client and an entitled action.
scenarios.procedure: Submit the selected valid authorization request; retain its original request and response.
scenarios.expected_behavior: The selected contract returns its permit outcome for this subject/action/resource.
scenarios.interpretation_note: A successful transport status alone does not establish the decision.

scenarios.title: Missing required entitlement
scenarios.preconditions: Reuse the S01 resource and action; select an authenticated test subject missing an entitlement required by the pinned rule.
scenarios.procedure: Submit the request and preserve the complete native decision response.
scenarios.expected_behavior: The selected contract returns its denial outcome.
scenarios.interpretation_note: Authentication failure does not establish the policy denial.

scenarios.title: Different requested action
scenarios.preconditions: Reuse S01 subject/resource; select a second action that the agreed policy does not entitle.
scenarios.procedure: Submit the second action while holding resource, identity and policy edition constant.
scenarios.expected_behavior: The selected contract denies the second action.
scenarios.interpretation_note: An earlier permit for another action is not evidence for this action.

scenarios.title: Authentication failure
scenarios.preconditions: Select an intentionally invalid test credential; preserve the same intended request dimensions without retaining the secret in the ordinary report.
scenarios.procedure: Make the request through the selected authenticated boundary and retain the authentication error.
scenarios.expected_behavior: The boundary rejects authentication according to the pinned contract; record authorization as not observed.
scenarios.interpretation_note: Do not translate this result into an authorization-policy denial.

scenarios.title: Invalid request structure
scenarios.preconditions: Select one exact request validation constraint from the pinned interface; construct a fixture violating only that constraint.
scenarios.procedure: Submit the malformed fixture and retain its precise structured error and transport status.
scenarios.expected_behavior: The interface returns the contract's specified validation error.
scenarios.interpretation_note: The violated field and contract clause are completed before execution; no generic HTTP code is assumed.

scenarios.title: Fresh request after policy change
scenarios.preconditions: Retain configuration A and its positive baseline; apply selected change B using the authorized test administration route; start a separately recorded clean client state.
scenarios.procedure: Observe configuration B; record the time and source of that observation; issue a fresh request after the agreed propagation interval.
scenarios.expected_behavior: The fresh request has the outcome specified for configuration B.
scenarios.interpretation_note: The selected interval, time uncertainty and cleared client state must be recorded.

scenarios.title: Retained client state after policy change
scenarios.preconditions: Use the same A-to-B change as S06; explicitly retain one identified prior credential/key/cache state in a separate test client.
scenarios.procedure: Exercise the selected client behavior and capture both its service interaction and client outcome.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Compare against the selected profile's stated retained-state behavior.
scenarios.interpretation_note: Complete the profile expectation first; previously obtained plaintext and fresh key access are different assertions.

scenarios.title: Obligation-dependent decision
scenarios.preconditions: Choose a contract/profile that defines the exact obligation under test and an enforcement client with a stated capability.
scenarios.procedure: Request the decision, retain every returned obligation, and operate the enforcement path while recording its handling.
scenarios.expected_behavior: The selected decision and obligation-handling assertions each match the profile.
scenarios.interpretation_note: Record authorization and enforcement separately; unknown obligations must remain in the original response.

scenarios.title: Dependency interruption and recovery
scenarios.preconditions: Identify an authorized isolated test dependency and selected recovery behavior; preserve the last complete state before interruption.
scenarios.procedure: Interrupt only that test dependency using the approved test control; record the failure; restore it and perform a separately identified recovery attempt.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Each attempt is assessed against its own availability or recovery assertion.
scenarios.interpretation_note: Preserve failure and recovery as separate runs; do not overwrite the failed observation with the successful retry.

scenarios.title: Complete object access
scenarios.preconditions: Fix original plaintext bytes, produced protected-object bytes, selected policy and entitled client.
scenarios.procedure: Perform the complete authorized access path; retain decision/key-access evidence when available and compare recovered bytes with the original fixture.
scenarios.expected_behavior: The end-to-end assertions in the selected profile are met, including exact recovered fixture bytes.
scenarios.interpretation_note: A decision-only response cannot complete this scenario.

scenarios.title: Cross-implementation comparison
scenarios.preconditions: Fix the scenario and source editions; retain the full native request mapping for implementation A and B.
scenarios.procedure: Execute the same assertion in each selected implementation; retain each native input and output independently.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Each implementation meets the selected assertion, and the documented mapping supports the comparison.
scenarios.interpretation_note: Any intentional difference is named; use the narrow profile/version/object scope in the conclusion.

scenarios.title: Independent report handover
scenarios.preconditions: Freeze a completed report edition and its member manifest; select a receiving location with the intended evidence permissions.
scenarios.procedure: Open the delivered report, follow scenario-to-run-to-evidence links, read the actual attachments, and reconstruct a selected assessment.
scenarios.expected_behavior: The recipient can locate every delivered item and identify the basis of the selected assessment.
scenarios.interpretation_note: Separately distributed controlled evidence must have a real route/custodian; redacted copies retain their original relationship.
